🌟 Experiment A: Market Characteristics Only (Headline Benchmark)
Estimating Modal Price & Classifying Price Tiers strictly from State, District, Market APMC, Commodity, and Category — Zero Price Leakage
Primary Benchmark
Methodology Note: This experiment tests whether market characteristics alone can estimate prices independently. Features are encoded via Target Encoding with cross-validation regularisation to prevent target leakage. Evaluated on 3,347 held-out test records (20% split).

📎 Experiment B: Market Characteristics + Trading Bounds (Supplementary Benchmark)
Evaluating performance when intraday Min_Price and Max_Price from the same market record are supplied
Supplementary Only
⚠️ Methodological Note: Intraday Min_Price and Max_Price originate from the exact same daily auction record as Modal_Price, establishing a tight mathematical bounding envelope [Min_Price ≤ Modal_Price ≤ Max_Price]. This experiment is provided strictly for boundary consistency verification, not as an independent market forecast.
